card.name: Digits and separators inside numbers
card.fires_on: Digits and separators (space, slash, decimal point) in the middle of numeric data, such as table values, fractions like n/N counts, dose pairs and citation volume numbers. It fires just before the next digit is written.

modes.label: Slash in counts and doses
modes.description: A slash between two numbers in a fraction, ratio or dose pair.

modes.label: Space or point in table rows
modes.description: A space or decimal point between numeric cells in a table row.

modes.label: Digit inside a citation number
modes.description: A middle digit of a volume number in a journal reference.

card.writes: It pushes toward digit-like and number-like continuations, but the promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot inside a run of numbers where another number is about to follow.
